description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller named ShippingConfigsController, which manages shipping configuration pages and AJAX endpoints for a web application. It handles displaying shipping configurations, saving updates, and managing supported shipping countries.

classes.name: ShippingConfigsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing shipping configurations in the admin panel, including displaying and updating shipping settings and supported countries.

methods.name: displayShippingConfigs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the shipping configuration page, initializing default configuration if none exists.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updated shipping configuration settings.

methods.name: pageCountries
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginated AJAX retrieval of country data, including support status.

methods.name: updateCountry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add or remove countries from the supported list.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set menu attributes in the model for UI rendering.
